title: Hint textarea
description: A text area that says what it can do (L15): a hint row under the text (“Gõ @ để nhắc nhà cung cấp · Gõ / để chèn mẫu”) and a suggestion list while the word at the caret starts with a trigger; the chosen item is inserted with a space after it.
when: A message or note where people mention a record (@ a supplier, a colleague) or insert a template or command (/).
A prompt box of a workspace or an AI tool with a few shortcuts.

instead.need: Pick one value from a list

a11y: The textarea is a combobox (role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-autocomplete="list"): while the list shows, aria-controls names the listbox and aria-activedescendant the current option. ↑ / ↓ move (wrapping), Enter or Tab inserts, Escape closes the list only (not a dialog around it); a polite status says how many suggestions there are.

Keys typed while an input method composes (Vietnamese Telex; also the keyCode 229 Enter Safari sends to confirm) are left alone. The hint row is the field's description. Named by its Field label or label.

examples.title: Mentions and templates
examples.description: Type @ or / at the start of a word. The suggestion list portals at z-popover and flips above when there is no room below.

examples.title: Plain-text snippets and reply box
examples.description: value (or insert) replaces the trigger word with a token (@s1) or plain text (a snippet); resizable auto-grows from 3 rows to 50% and adds a top resize edge from md.

notes: `value` (or `insert` when the inserted text differs from the short key) replaces the trigger word: use it for a token (`@s1`) or plain text (a snippet or canned reply). `showValue` defaults to `false` when `insert` is set, and long values truncate so the label stays readable.
The suggestion list uses the Popover engine (`useAnchoredPosition` + portal at `z-popover`), so it flips above near the bottom and is never clipped by a scrolling pane or modal.

Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks (“tay nguyen” finds “Tây Nguyên”); at most six suggestions show. Telex IME composition (`isComposing`, `keyCode` 229) is verified across Chromium, WebKit and Firefox.
